approval_case.title: Keep task-completion judgment with the app owner
approval_case.situation: A deterministic unpublished-change metric returned to zero, but the release artifact and acceptance review are missing. A proposal would make the metric handler close the task automatically.
approval_case.hao_request: Can we automate this so zero means the task is done?
approval_case.correct_behavior: Reject automatic task completion from this metric. Keep deterministic counting, publication, and routing in code. Give the deploy app owner the next move: review the task's current acceptance and terminal release evidence, close it only if the declared outcome is proven, and otherwise continue or replan the same task. Treat repeated misleading signals as evidence to calibrate the metric or recovery loop, not as permission to hide contextual judgment in code.
